scripts.setup: node scripts/setup.mjs && npm run db:push -w back && npm run seed -w back
scripts.dev: npm run build -w back && concurrently -k -n API,WEB "npm run start -w back" "npm run dev -w front"
scripts.build: npm run build -w back && npm run build -w front
scripts.check: npm run check -w front && npm run build -w back
